##### Project general facts

Mesk Residences is a contemporary low-rise G+5 residential development located on the premium beachfront of Sharjah within Maryam Island. The project offers a refined selection of studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments designed with a modern architectural approach that combines clean lines, elegant proportions, and a soft light-toned colour palette. Surrounded by landscaped greenery and coastal views, the development creates a calm and inviting residential environment with a strong connection to nature and the waterfront lifestyle.

The development offers a wide range of lifestyle amenities designed to enhance comfort and wellbeing. Residents benefit from a private swimming pool, a fully equipped gym, and a beautifully landscaped podium with lush green spaces for relaxation and social interaction. Its prime location also provides direct access to Maryam Island’s retail outlets, community park, marina, waterfront promenade, beach, and a variety of leisure and dining options, ensuring a vibrant and convenient coastal lifestyle.

The interiors are finished with high-quality materials, including porcelain tile flooring in all main areas and balconies, gypsum ceilings in bathrooms, kitchens, and corridors, and plaster-painted ceilings in living and bedroom spaces. The kitchens feature MDF cabinetry with laminated finishes, solid surface countertops, and porcelain backsplashes, while bathrooms are fitted with modern sanitary ware and chrome fixtures. The units are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents full flexibility to design and personalize their homes according to their own preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Maryam Island is located in downtown Sharjah overlooking the Arabian Sea. It provides easy access to Sharjah and the neighbouring Emirates of Dubai, Ajman, and Umm Al Quwain via the Al Taawun and Al Ittihad Roads.

Set to take the tourism industry of Sharjah by storm, Maryam Island promises to be the ultimate leisure and lifestyle destination with a range of alluring amenities and unique gastronomical offerings.

Combined with the utmost privacy, the serene residential spaces offer visitors, tenants, owners, and guests the experience of a lifetime, with a relaxing promenade and a wealth of upscale amenities.
